revision: Fix forward of F-03.2.1a: its closure ignored provides, conflicts and replaces and pinned both sqlite and sqlite3, which sqlite replaces, conflicts with and provides (130 overlapping paths, 66 with different content). Re-resolved from the same signed database by tools/msys2_lock.py; hardlink policy recorded.

provider.name: qemu
provider.licence: GPL-2.0 (QEMU as a whole, per its LICENSE); package metadata: GPL-2.0-or-later AND LGPL-2.1-or-later AND BSD-2-Clause AND BSD-3-Clause AND MIT

repository.note: The package sha256 values below are copied from this signed database. The database is replaced on every repository update; old package files stay on the mirror.

extraction.tool: tools/msys2_lock.py install. Windows' built-in %SystemRoot%\System32\tar.exe (bsdtar 3.8.9, libarchive 3.8.9 with libzstd 1.5.7) decodes each archive to an uncompressed pax stream on stdout and writes nothing; the tool validates every entry and writes the regular files and directories itself. No other tool is installed or run.
extraction.entry_rules: Every entry of every archive is listed and validated before anything is written: no absolute path, drive letter, '..', '.' or empty component, control or Windows-special character (\ : * ? " < > |), reserved device name or trailing dot or space; only regular files and directories, plus hardlinks under the link policy; metadata names only at the archive root; installed paths under 250 characters. Extraction re-reads each archive and refuses any entry that differs from its validated listing.

link_policy.symlinks: Refused. A package holding symlinks is extracted only if it is marked "extract": false (data only), in which case it is hash-checked and not extracted.
link_policy.hardlinks: materialise-as-copy: each hardlink is written as a regular-file copy of its target, after checking that the target is a regular file earlier in the same package, that link and target are both under ucrt64/, and that both resolved paths stay inside the install directory. Any other link stops the install. No link is created on disk. A package's "hardlinks" count must match its archive.
link_policy.decided_by: Overseer decision on A2 (2026-11-06), within the Owner's A2 condition 3.

extraction.overlap_rule: No two packages of the resolved set install the same path (compared case-insensitively; shared directories allowed). Checked over every package, including those not extracted, when the lock is made and again at install. Files are created exclusively, so nothing is overwritten.
extraction.not_run: pacman, its post-install hooks (usr/share/libalpm/hooks) and .INSTALL scripts. They refresh GTK, GIO, fontconfig and gdk-pixbuf caches, which a -display none guest does not use.

resolution.rules: libalpm dependency semantics: a dependency is met by a selected package, else by the package of that name, else by its only provider; versioned dependencies use alpm vercmp; a package another repository package replaces and provides is never chosen; of two conflicting selected packages, the one the other provides is dropped, any other conflict stops; finally no two packages may install the same path
decisions: mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-sqlite3 -> mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-sqlite (provider; mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-sqlite3 is replaced by mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-sqlite)

packages.name: mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-iso-codes
packages.extract_reason: Data only (no executables or DLLs). Its 470 locale entries are symbolic links, which the link policy refuses (no link is created on disk). Downloaded, hash-checked and validated like every package, but not extracted.
